answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The relic counter is kept in zenith and bridge publishes each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Repeating the trick 50 times costs 40 separate deposits and 8 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
